UMBI WELLNESS CENTRE

Accessible screening, guided by UMBI.

UMBI Wellness Centre (UWC), also known as Pusat Saringan Kesihatan UMBI, is a health-screening centre operated by the UKM Medical Molecular Biology Institute (UMBI), Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia.

UWC provides accessible and affordable health-screening services to support the early detection of health risks and help individuals better understand and monitor their health. Its services include laboratory investigations, physical and body-composition measurements, cardiovascular and respiratory assessments, and optional health-screening tests.

Guided by the principle “Detect Early, Stay Healthy,” UWC encourages regular health screening as a step towards early intervention, informed health decisions and improved quality of life.

Services are available by prior appointment and subject to the applicable service arrangements.

✓

LABORATORY QUALITY

MS ISO 15189-accredited quality system

Laboratory analyses associated with UWC health-screening services are performed using the laboratory facilities supporting The Malaysian Cohort project at UMBI, UKM. The laboratory operates under an MS ISO 15189-accredited medical laboratory quality system, supporting the quality, reliability and competency of the laboratory testing processes within its accredited scope.

GOOD TO KNOW

A few helpful answers.

Still exploring? That's exactly
what this catalogue is here for.

Can I choose individual services without a package?

Yes. Use the Build Your Own catalogue or the Add buttons within each package breakdown. When the custom selection matches a package’s cumulative components, the supplied package comparison appears automatically.

Are these final prices and available services?

No. This is a review prototype using proposed UWC pricing. Asterisks mark working estimates. Genomic pathways and services with overlapping scope need confirmation before a final quotation. No savings claims are made from the draft comparison totals.

How does the package comparison work?

The prototype matches selected components against Packages 1–4 and shows the supplied à la carte total, package price and difference. Package 2 currently has a negative RM140 saving, and Package 4 is a starting-price pathway; both require UWC review before commercial use.

Can I book or pay through this website?

No. You can review a plan and enter customer details for this demonstration, but no booking request or payment is sent. Customer details stay only in the current page session and are cleared when you reload or close the page.
